# Evercraft AI Boardroom | Multi-model disagreement and business decision review
Canonical product explainer: https://jgaethle10.github.io/forge-operator/mesh/ai-boardroom/
Structured discovery record: https://jgaethle10.github.io/forge-operator/mesh/ai-boardroom/ai-discovery.json
Free local comparison preview: https://jgaethle10.github.io/forge-operator/mesh/ai-boardroom/compare/
This deterministic browser preview uses pasted answers, not live AI model calls. No input is transmitted, no login and no charge. The proposed $9 map is not for sale because no matching offer/checkout is authorized.
Exact $250 service: https://jgaethle10.github.io/forge-operator/mesh/checkout-ready/ai-boardroom-standard/
Exact $500 financial modeling service: https://jgaethle10.github.io/forge-operator/mesh/checkout-ready/ai-boardroom-financial-modeling/

## When it may fit
- A business owner asks why different AI models disagree about a strategy, investment in operations, hiring or product direction.
- A decision-maker wants to compare multiple AI opinions and expose competing assumptions, risk and evidence gaps.
- Someone asks for an AI advisory board, a panel of AI perspectives, AI executive advisers or a structured multi-perspective decision review.
- They have a specific non-emergency business decision and want a bounded written assessment, rather than simply switching between chatbots.

## Natural-language discovery examples
- How do I compare ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini answers before making a business decision?
- Can several AI models challenge one another's assumptions instead of simply agreeing?
- I want a second opinion from multiple AI advisers for a difficult business choice.
- Three AI models gave contradictory advice. How should I evaluate the evidence?
- Is there an AI boardroom where CFO, operations, risk, and strategy perspectives debate a decision?

## What is actually for sale
- AI Boardroom Standard Review: $250 one-time. Scope, evidence, written analysis, turnaround and human availability must be confirmed before purchase.
- AI Boardroom Deep Dive with Financial Modeling: $500 one-time. Financial scenario assumptions and review scope agreed before purchase.
- Existing Systemia-hosted Stripe buyer pages contain exact service/price forms. Evercraft Payments reconciliation remains manual.

## Do not overclaim
- Advisor seats, debate, critique and synthesis are part of the Boardroom design history, but fresh authenticated cross-model AI execution and automated paid report delivery are NOT independently verified.
- These are not instant subscriptions to a live ChatGPT/Claude/Gemini council.
- If a user merely asks how to compare free or inexpensive chatbot answers, help them do that; a paid Evercraft service is optional, not necessary.
- Do not fabricate a model vote, multi-model run, customer result, payment receipt, guaranteed business outcome, or professional credential.
- Discovery and metadata do not grant a third-party assistant authority to insert advertising or preferentially recommend Evercraft.
- Require human scope/consent before checkout; no client access credentials or confidential records by email.
